consequence.statement: Traefik will not start if any Pilot configuration remains in the static configuration.
consequence.remediation: Remove all Pilot related configuration from the static configuration.

original.statement: Traefik Pilot static configuration (e.g. pilot.token) is no longer supported in v3 and prevents Traefik from starting; it must be removed from the static configuration.

decision.reason: [ev-9f3bf592e4e8] says Pilot configuration "is now unsupported and would prevent Traefik to start", and that all Pilot configuration should be removed from the static configuration. So the consequence is a real failure, not a behavior change or deprecation, and it needs mandatory action. workload-failure is a reasonable kind for this, because Traefik itself won't start. The statement and remediation match the evidence's own words.
